summary: Server-first parser sanitizer. Faster than DOMPurify-on-jsdom and far lighter than dragging in jsdom, but its defaults are aggressive: img and svg are removed unless you allow them. Zero executions in the harness; 17 historical advisories, all fixed, and the current release is clean.
reasoning: 0 of 25 vectors executed after sanitization; the control executed 11.
About 400 sanitizations per second on a 60 KB document in Node, versus 49 for DOMPurify running on jsdom.
Works without a DOM, which makes it the right choice for SSR and background jobs.
2.18.1 is clean in OSV and includes fixes for several October 2026 CVEs.
Six direct dependencies install to 16 packages and 4.1 MB, versus 27.4 MB for jsdom.
Default output escapes disallowed markup and drops dangerous tags entirely.
caveats: Defaults drop img and svg. If you need images, add them to allowedTags explicitly; several historic advisories involved SVG and URI schemes.
The standalone GitHub repository is archived. Source now lives in the Apostrophe monorepo, which makes targeted review harder.
17 advisories, including a CRITICAL xmp passthrough fixed in 2.17.4 and an October 2026 SMIL bypass fixed in 2.18.0. Pin and update.

evidence.label: Bypass test
evidence.detail: 25 vectors; 0 executed. Static flags were false positives on escaped text (the vector was rendered as visible markup, not parsed).

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV returns 0 advisories for 2.18.1, which fixes the October 2026 iframe-recursion and SMIL-prefix issues.

evidence.label: Advisory history
evidence.detail: 17 advisories since 2016, all fixed. Several in 2026: xmp passthrough (CRITICAL, 2.17.4), URI schemes in action/formaction (2.17.5), textarea solidus mXSS (2.17.6), SMIL (2.17.7).

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 6 direct dependencies, 16 installed packages, 4.1 MB install, 83 KB unpacked.

evidence.label: Throughput
evidence.detail: ~400 ops/s on a 60 KB document in Node, about 8x DOMPurify on jsdom.

evidence.label: CI publish pipeline
evidence.detail: Monorepo CI runs tests only; no npm publish job. No provenance on any of 128 versions.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 2.18.1 published 2026-10-14; three releases in 90 days; active in the Apostrophe monorepo.
